adjudication.rationale: The diff replaces the prior `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` check with `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` in both `app/controllers/embed_controller.rb` (`ensure_embeddable`) and `lib/topic_retriever.rb` (`invalid_host?`). `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` calls `record_for_host`, which executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (a DB query) after parsing the URL. There is no caching shown in the diff, so this introduces a synchronous database round-trip on these request paths, which is a concrete performance/architecture concern grounded in the new code, though not necessarily a functional defect.
